readme:
# Bazos Classifieds Scraper

Scrape classified ads from [Bazos](https://www.bazos.sk), the largest free classifieds platform in Central Europe. Covers Slovakia (bazos.sk), Czechia (bazos.cz), Austria (bazos.at), and Poland (bazos.pl).

## How it works

1. Choose a country (`sk`, `cz`, `at`, or `pl`)
2. Enter a search keyword
3. Optionally filter by category (auto, elektro, mobil, reality, etc.)
4. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/bazos-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `bazos-scraper` to scrape company data from bazos. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in EUR, CZK, or PLN |
| `location` | City and postal code |
| `category` | Listing category |
| `image_url` | Thumbnail image |
| `views` | Number of views |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on Bazos |

## Pricing

No start fee -- pay only for results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing | $0.003 |

**100 listings = $0.30** | **1,000 listings = $3.00**

## Examples

### iPhones in Slovakia
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "iphone",
  "country": "sk",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Multiple searches in Czechia
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["iphone", "samsung galaxy", "pixel"],
  "country": "cz",
  "category": "mobil",
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

### Cars in Austria
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "auto",
  "country": "at",
  "category": "auto",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```
